headline: Colombia Central Bank Nine-Month Net Result Drops 45% to September
summary: Banco de la República recorded a net profit of 5.98 trillion pesos for the January to September period, down 45% from 10.96 trillion pesos generated in the same period of 2025.
why: Central bank balance sheet earnings in emerging markets reflect monetary policy returns, FX reserve valuations, and fiscal remittances to national treasuries.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Lower central bank net profits decrease potential surplus transfers to the central government.
